text: Shell.jsx's <main> padding: var(--eb-space-6) is the single source of the page gutter on ALL FOUR sides (not just horizontal); PatternsCatalog.jsx, SdlcCatalogPage.jsx, and MainframeCatalogPage.jsx each additionally set their own page-level padding (var(--eb-space-8)/var(--eb-space-6)) on their outer wrapper, doubling the inset — same bug class as KnowledgeFlow.jsx's redundant space-4 padding (#533), fixed together in PR #535.

KB storage branch (env.knowledgeStore.repoRef.branch, resolved by resolveKnowledgeBranch in orchestrator/knowledge-sync.js) is a SEPARATE concept from a repository's code branch; normalizeKnowledgeStore's in-repo fallback must adopt only a repo's url+credentials (adoptRepoForKnowledge), never its code branch, or an unconfigured team silently pushes knowledge to the code branch. Default KB branch is 'agent-knowledge' (not protected).

Knowledge-learning settings (autonomy/review/promotion-gates) are rendered by ONE shared React component admin-console/src/components/KnowledgeLearningConfig.jsx (default export KnowledgeLearningSections; exports AUTONOMY_LEVELS/GATE_ORDER/GATE_LABELS/GATE_TIPS/KNOWLEDGE_LEARNING_DEFAULTS/PanelSection), consumed by BOTH the Knowledge-page slide-out panel (KnowledgeFlow.jsx, PUTs live) and the Team-Setup wizard Knowledge step (TeamSetup.jsx, mutates form state; readOnly in extend mode). Storage config is intentionally NOT in this component (KnowledgeFlow-only). Added in PR #579 (#567); don't reintroduce a divergent second copy of the copy/controls.

Role templates are a two-tier store (#587/PR#591): repo-seeded defaults in AGENT_TEMPLATES_DIR (wiped by make seed-templates) are overlaid by a durable user store USER_AGENT_TEMPLATES_DIR=/workspace/agent-templates; admin-console read loaders listAgentTemplateIds/loadAgentTemplate are overlay-aware (user file shadows default), so UI create/edit/delete of role templates survives a re-seed and is picked up by wizard/Flow picker without redeploy.

GET /api/auth/session (admin-console/api/auth.js ~192-196) returns only {authenticated, user:{username}} — NO role/scope/systemAdmin flag; so AuthContext.jsx (user={username}) and Shell.jsx (static NAV array, no role filter) can't hide admin-only nav/pages for non-System-Admins. Exposing caller role+memberships here is the frontend prerequisite for team-visibility gating (issue #584).

In the knowledge CLI (agent-image/scripts/knowledge), _git() prepends `git -C <checkout>`, so a caller can inject inline `-c user.name=...`/`-c user.email=...` via its args to set committer identity per-commit (valid `git -C <root> -c ... commit`), mirroring gh-as-agent commit — committer email is agent-<id>@ace.local while the author marker stays <id>@agents.local for poller loop-protection.

The composed CLAUDE.md Skills section (prompt-assembly.js skillsSection) now injects each granted skill's SKILL.md `description` (name + one-line desc), resolved via resolveSkillSourceDir (agent→team→global, same tier as seeding); assembleClaudeMd stays pure by taking a caller-supplied skillDescriptions map read in buildAgentClaudeMd (orchestrator.js).

prompt-assembly.js interactionNote() preamble contains em-dashes (' — '), so a test asserting 'no ` — ` separator' must scope to the relevant section (e.g. md.split('## Skills')[1]), not the whole composed CLAUDE.md.
